summary.en: Thai authorities are intensifying border negotiations with Cambodia as Prime Minister Hun Manet invites former opposition lawmaker Um Sam An to discuss disputed territory, while China‑hosted Track II talks aim for lasting peace. Environmental pressure has risen as poison from Burma flows into the Chiang Rai river basin, prompting calls for Thai action. The government is tightening price checks during the Vegetarian Festival and advancing a large‑scale power‑grid project linking Thailand with Malaysia, Myanmar and Singapore. A Filipina trafficking victim with stage‑IV breast cancer was repatriated safely from Thailand. The conflict caused 35 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Thai‑myndighetene intensiverer grenseforhandlingene med Kambodsja ettersom statsminister Hun Manet inviterer tidligere opposisjonslovgiver Um Sam An til å diskutere omstridt territorium, mens Kina‑vertede Track II‑samtaler har som mål varig fred. Miljøpresset har økt ettersom gift fra Burma renner inn i Chiang Rai‑vassdraget, og dette har ført til krav om thailandsk handling. Regjeringen strammer inn priskontroller under vegetarfestivalen og fremmer et storskala kraftnettprosjekt som knytter Thailand til Malaysia, Myanmar og Singapore. En filippinsk menneskehandels‑offer med stadium‑IV brystkreft ble trygt repatriert fra Thailand. Konflikten forårsaket 35 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Southern Thailand insurgency
background.extract: The Southern Thailand insurgency is an ongoing conflict centered in southern Thailand. It originated in 1948 as a separatist insurgency in the historical Malay Patani Region, made up of the three southernmost provinces of Thailand and parts of a fourth, but has become more complex and increasingly violent since the early 2000s from drug cartels, oil smuggling networks, and sometimes pirate raids.
